_comment: Gleo AI App Schema (DRAFT). Pleos docs: an app ships assets/schema.json + matching intent-filters; Gleo scans it at boot and after install, reviews it, then activates the integration. Field names follow the function-calling style shown in the Gleo Interface core-concepts page and must be validated against the official 'App Schema Writing Guide' before submission.

app.name: Drive Symphony
